theme: Light mode primary for the public marketing site to convey a warm, editorial, and elegant tone. The Admin CMS should support a light/dark toggle or default to a clean light UI.

headings.usage_rules: Use for H1-H3. H1 max text-5xl/6xl with tracking-tight. H2 at text-4xl. Use font-normal or font-medium. Do not use generic sans-serif for headings on the public site.

body.usage_rules: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, input fields. Apply text-base with leading-relaxed for optimal readability.

accents.usage_rules: Use tracking-[0.2em] for overlines, labels, small buttons, and metadata (text-xs or text-sm).

primary.name: Terracotta
primary.usage: Primary CTA buttons, active states, key highlights. Evokes warmth, care, and approachability.

secondary.name: Muted Sage
secondary.usage: Secondary buttons, section backgrounds, subtle trust indicators. Represents calm, health, and nature.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, diffuse ambient shadows for cards and floating elements: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]. Avoid harsh, hard shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Delicate 1px borders (border-black/5 or border-sage/20) for subtle separation without creating a boxy feel.
visual_enhancers.corners: Nested radii: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for large cards and images. Use pill-shaped buttons (rounded-full).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky nav/mobile bar: use crystal glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays on dark sections to create a premium, tactile, editorial feel.

marketing.strategy: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Avoid overusing Shadcn for layout. Use pure divs and sections for overlapping, asymmetry, and editorial layouts.
marketing.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), uppercase tracking-wider. Primary: bg-terracotta text-white hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all. Secondary: border border-black/10 hover:border-black/30.
marketing.cards: Go for a cardless or soft-card look. Use large editorial images with text floating next to them. If using cards, ensure subtle borders with generous padding (p-8 to p-12).
marketing.forms: Enquiry forms should use Shadcn logic but be heavily styled to match the premium marketing look (no default Vercel aesthetic).

admin.strategy: Use Shadcn/UI components (tables, forms, dialogs, cards). Strict grid hierarchy, dense layout, functional beauty.
admin.colors: High contrast primary (Terracotta) + neutral greys. Clean white surfaces.
admin.layout: Sidebar navigation (left), main content area, standard dashboard pattern.

grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Mode A 'Tetris' Grid for Gallery and Packages. Use col-span-full md:col-span-8 for hero elements, col-span-4 for supporting elements. Wide gaps (gap-8).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Sections should have py-24 or py-32. Internal padding for borders must be p-8 or p-12 to avoid cramping.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Eyebrow text (uppercase), large Playfair Display H1, concise description, primary + secondary CTAs. Max 80vh height on mobile. Use transparent-to-black/30 gradients for image text overlays.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (subtle lift -translate-y-1, shadow expansion).
motion.scroll: Fade-in up for staggered lists/gallery items on scroll.
motion.micro: Smooth accordion expansions for FAQs. Mobile mega menu should animate gracefully.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. Terracotta on white and white on Terracotta are accessible.

images.description: Elegant pointer dog portrait, high contrast
Fluffy dog portrait, warm and friendly
Premium grooming facility with white robe
Person sitting at table with white cat
French bulldog on vet table, clean modern clinic

media.treatment: Use object-cover for images. Max 80vh on mobile to prevent scrolling fatigue. Do not use fully rounded corners unless for avatars; default to rounded-2xl.

specific_features.navigation: Desktop: Mega Menu for Services. Mobile: Accordion menu. Sticky header MUST have a background (e.g., bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) - never fully transparent.
specific_features.contact: Floating WhatsApp + Call buttons fixed at bottom right (z-50). Optional mobile sticky CTA bar at bottom for 'Book Now'.
specific_features.book_now: Redirects to external ERP URL. Open in new tab (target='_blank').
specific_features.enquiry_form: Separate from booking, standard contact form styled to match the theme (not default Shadcn).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize HTML/Tailwind for the public site structure. Do not wrap everything in generic Shadcn Cards.
Use Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text.
Ensure all buttons and interactive elements have hover animations (e.g., -translate-y-1 and shadow changes).
Build the Admin CMS using Shadcn components (sidebar, dense grids, tables) at a separate route (e.g., /admin).
Make sure there's a floating WhatsApp icon on the public site.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, menus, etc) for automated testing.
Implement the Bento grid strategy for the gallery and services.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; it must have a blur and slight color to ensure text is readable.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic, 'on-distribution' outputs. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do not apply `transition: all` universally. Use specific transitions.
Do not center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Keep text left-aligned for natural reading.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Add micro-animations for hover states and list entrances.
